Egotistical

ee-guh-TIS-tih-kul -- from egotist ('a person absorbed in themselves') + -ical: egotistical describes someone who centers everything on themselves. · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

To be egotistical is to be self-centered or blatantly prideful.

The egotistical quarterback refused to share credit with his teammates, insisting every win belonged to him alone.

Worked Example

During the interview, the actor spent forty minutes describing his own genius and never once asked the reporter a question about herself -- a textbook egotistical performance.

Egotistical behavior centers every conversation and situation on oneself, often at other people's expense -- notice how the pattern is dismissing or ignoring others, not just confidence.

How Egotistical Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

self-absorbed

self-absorbed: focused only on one's own concerns

conceited

conceited: having an excessively high opinion of oneself

Antonyms

humble

humble: modest, not boastful

unassuming

unassuming: not arrogant or self-important

How Strong Is It? — vain → egotistical → self-important

vain vs. egotistical

vain vs. egotistical: Vain focuses narrowly on one's appearance or achievements.

self-important vs. egotistical

self-important vs. egotistical: Self-important goes further than egotistical, suggesting someone who acts as though their opinions and needs automatically outrank everyone else's.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — egotist-

root — egotist-: a person absorbed in their own importance (ego, Latin 'I' + -ist)

suffix — -ical

suffix — -ical: having the qualities of; pertaining to

Put it together

Put it together: Egotistical comes from egotist -- someone absorbed in their own importance, built from ego ('I') plus -ist -- plus -ical. Egotistical describes behavior that centers everything on oneself, often at other people's expense.

Use the root in a new word: egotism

Use the root in a new word: egotism: His constant bragging revealed an egotism that even his closest friends found exhausting.

Root Check

Word Choice

Egotistical is almost always negative -- reserve it for someone whose self-focus actively harms or annoys others, not simply someone who is confident.
